question: what is the recommended course sequence for the nursing major freshman year
answer:
For Nursing (Bachelor of Science in Nursing), the recommended plan is for students admitted during the 2026–2027 academic year [2].

**First Year, Fall Semester (total 17 credits):** INTD 101 – FIRST YEAR SEMINAR (4); CHEM 111 – PRINCIPLES OF CHEMISTRY LECTURE (4); CHEM 111L – PRINCIPLES OF CHEM LAB/RECITAT (1); CRWT 102 – CRITICAL READING AND WRITING II (4); General Education Requirement * (4); PATH 001 – CAREER PATHWAYS MOD 1. [2]

**First Year, Spring Semester (total 16 credits):** General Education Requirement * (4); General Education Requirement * (4); PSYC 101 – INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY (4); Quantitative Reasoning – MATH 108 – ELEMENTARY PROBABILITY AND STATISTICS (4). [2]

This plan lists 128 total credits required and a 2.3 GPA required. Placement: CRWT 101 to CRWT 102; CRWT 101S to CRWT 102S. Math Placement: MATH 021/022 to MATH 108-121. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURG)

question: im a nursing student, which gen ed categories do i still have to fill if my major already has chem and bio
answer:
Ramapo’s General Education curriculum includes four keystone courses (First Year Seminar, Social Science Inquiry, Critical Reading & Writing 102, and Studies in the Arts & Humanities); one course each in Global Awareness, Historical Perspectives, Scientific Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning; and one course in two of three distribution categories. Critical Reading & Writing 102 and Quantitative Reasoning must be taken within the first 64 credits. [9]

For Fall 2026, the distribution categories are Culture and Creativity, Values and Ethics, and Social Systems and Society; choose two. The page says the “out of school requirement” is no longer enforced in degree audit tools. [10] Another page calls the third category “Systems, Sustainability, & Society.” The pages differ in that category’s name. [9][10]

BIOL 101, CHEM 101, CHEM 111/111L, and CHEM 116/116L are listed as Scientific Reasoning courses. [16] So those exact courses can satisfy that category, but I can’t verify which courses you took or which categories remain on your audit. Contact the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising): success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, D-207. [13]

question: what are the prereqs for microbiology? and do i need to finish them before sophmore year to stay on track for nursing
answer:
If you mean BIOL 311 MICROBIOLOGY LECTURE (4 credits), the catalog requires one biology option: BIOL 110; BIOL 111 and BIOL 111L; BIOL 112; or BIOL 113 and BIOL 113L. It also requires one chemistry option: CHEM 205; CHEM 206 and CHEM 206L; CHEM 210; or CHEM 211 and CHEM 211L. A chemistry option may be completed concurrently with BIOL 311. You must also be enrolled in BIOL 311L MICROBIOLOGY LABORATORY (1.5 credits); the lab requires enrollment in BIOL 311. [4][5] The Registrar says to “satisfactorily complete all prerequisites before registering.” [6]

For Nursing Generic BSN, the 2026–2027 recommended plan places BIOL 212 and BIOL 212L in Second Year, Spring Semester (total 15 credits). [2] That is a different course from BIOL 311, and the pages provided do not give BIOL 212’s prerequisites or say whether BIOL 311 prerequisites must be completed before sophomore year. [2][4] Contact the School of Science, Nursing, and Health Office at SNHOffice@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7734 about BIOL 212 and your sequence. [2]

question: what GPA do you need to stay in the nursing program and what courses are the prerequisites before you start clinicals
answer:
The catalog lists a 2.3 GPA required for the Nursing major for graduation [2, 7]. The pages provided do not state a separate GPA needed to remain in the program, so I can’t verify a retention GPA. [1, 2, 7]

Prerequisites depend on your track:
• Generic BSN: pre-nursing courses are BIOL 212 and 212L, BIOL 214 and 214L, BIOL 216 and 216L, CHEM 111 and 111L, PSYC 101, and one of MATH 108 or PSYC 242. [2] Nursing courses require a C+ or better. [2]
• Accelerated BSN: required Bridge courses are BIOL 212 and 212L, BIOL 214 and 214L, BIOL 216 and 216L, CHEM 111 and 111L, MATH 108, and PSYC 101; students must earn a C+ or better in all Bridge courses to proceed to Nursing courses. [1]
The pages don’t specify which of these must be completed before clinicals specifically. Contact the Nursing Programs Office at (201) 684-7749, Adler Center for Nursing Excellence 215, to confirm for your track.

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURA) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BSN-NURG)

question: can psych 101 count for both gen ed social science and a requirement for the health science major

question: what order should i take chem courses in for allied health / pre-PT? gen chem then organic?
answer:
Yes: the Chemistry BS plan sequences General Chemistry I (CHEM 116 and 116L), then General Chemistry II (CHEM 117 and 117L), then Organic Chemistry I (CHEM 211 and 211L), then Organic Chemistry II (CHEM 213 and 213L). The plan is for students admitted to Chemistry during 2026–2027; it is a recommended sequence, not a pre-PT-specific plan. [1]

For prerequisites, select Chemistry on the Registrar’s course-prerequisites page. [2] Satisfactorily complete prerequisites before registering; review them in Web Self Service and check course descriptions there. [3] If you are a transfer or visiting student who has met a prerequisite but cannot register, contact the academic school offering the course; if you prove you met it, the unit secretary may place an override, after which you must register in Experience: https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/. [3]

Ramapo’s Pre-Medical/Pre-Health Club welcomes aspiring physical therapists. [4] For academic advisement, the Center for Student Success is the primary resource. [18]

question: should i switch from nursing to health science if im struggling with the science classes
answer:
Whether you should switch is a personal decision; the pages don’t give verified advice about your situation. They recommend gathering information, considering which subjects interest you and where you get the best grades, choosing classes to help decide, and talking with faculty and professional advisors. The Center for Student Success specializes in helping students choose majors. [4]

The Nursing Generic BSN requires BIOL 212/212L, BIOL 214/214L, BIOL 216/216L, CHEM 111/111L, PSYC 101, and one of MATH 108 or PSYC 242 before the nursing sequence. [2] The catalog also lists Nursing Accelerated BSN and Nursing RN to BSN; the requirements differ by track. [1][3]

For a major change, meet with the convener of your major; Change of Major forms are available through the Registrar’s website. [5] The Registrar says students may change majors during a semester; complete the Major and Minor Declaration Online form at https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/declare-major-minor-certificate/. Changes take 5–7 days; do not submit multiple requests. It recommends changing before the next registration cycle. [10][11]

Contact the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) at success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, D-207, or the Registrar at reg@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7695, D-224. [4][11]
